summary_en: Interim dividend of JPY 25 per share and full-year dividend of JPY 55 per share (previously JPY 30), representing increases of JPY 5 and JPY 15 respectively. Full-year EPS guidance raised to JPY 121.16 from JPY 90.92, reflecting stronger performance in energy and green segments.
title_en: Notice of Revision of Business Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 and Determination of Interim and Full-Year Dividend Predictions with Increase
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Fuji United Holdings announced increases to both interim and full-year dividend per share. The interim dividend was set at JPY 25 per share, an increase of JPY 5 from the prior interim payment of JPY 20. The full-year dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 was revised upward to JPY 55 per share, representing an increase of JPY 15 from the previously announced JPY 30.

These dividend increases accompany upward revisions to full-year earnings guidance. Net earnings per share attributable to parent company shareholders were raised to JPY 121.16 from JPY 90.92 previously forecast, a 33.3% increase. Operating profit guidance was increased by JPY 300 million to JPY 1,300 million. The revision reflects stronger-than-expected performance across multiple business segments.

The primary drivers of the earnings upgrade were strong results in the energy segment, particularly the petroleum business, which benefited from elevated crude oil prices stemming from Middle East geopolitical tensions. In the green segment, recycling business results improved due to accelerated execution of large-scale emergency cleanup work, and home energy business profitability increased through the deferral of certain maintenance investments to the second half. The company maintained its prior-year profit of JPY 109.94 per share as reference performance.
